title: Canonical CI Result
description: One execution source's complete verdict for one exact commit SHA: every check context with its status, plus the environment fingerprint that explains divergence between sources. Composes with exact-head-truth/1.0 (each result entry is truth-bindable via repo+sha+run_id+timestamp).

sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA this result binds to

source.description: Origin system that produced this result (same enum as exact-head-truth/1.0)

run_id.description: Unique execution identifier (CI run ID, WORKS work ID, or UUID)

attempt.description: Attempt number for this run_id (retries increment)

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp when this result was recorded

versions.description: Tool versions that affect verdicts (python, go, node, ...)

package_installed.description: Whether the repo package was installed before testing (AIE truth-gap lesson: missing install flips verdicts)

results.description: Per-context verdicts; every entry inherits repo/sha/source/run_id/timestamp
